newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares rise against European trend.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares rise against European trend.

text.p: Boosted by strong gains from shipping group A.P. Moeller Danish share prices ignored falls on main European markets and rose by over one percent on Thursday.
At 1140 GMT the KFX top-20 index had risen 2.23 point from Wednesday's close -- a 1.36 percent gain -- to 166.13. Its June future was up 1.85 point, to 165.00
The Moeller group's D/S Svendborg B share was up 3.75 percent, by 12,000 crowns, to 332,000. D/S 1912 B was up 5,000 crowns to 232,000, a 2.2 percent rise.
Its less traded A shares, and were up respectively 16,000 crowns to 332,000 and 11,000 crowns to 230,000, both rises of five percent.

Dealers said they were pushed up by a knock-on effect after better-than-expected first quarter results from Norwegian shipping heavyweight Bergesen, compounded by a lack of Moeller shares for sale. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 3396950
